name: Challenges
tagline: Structured, completable objectives with a visible endpoint that users opt into, typically with social or competitive dimensions.
desc: Unlike quests, challenges often have optional opt-in and social visibility. For the Competitor, time-limited challenges with ranked outcomes are the natural habitat. The opt-in nature respects user autonomy while social visibility creates ambient competitive pressure for those who choose to participate.
principle: Voluntary commitment with visible accountability. The user chose this goal, which makes completion more meaningful and abandonment more costly.
warn: Challenges set too high alienate new users. The ideal challenge is achievable for the median user with meaningful effort. Challenges requiring subscription access before participation create resentment.
lifecycle: Mid-to-late lifecycle. Strongest once the user has formed a baseline habit.
